products.name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
products.issuer: Government of India (Department of Economic Affairs)
products.tax_note: EEE treatment under the Income-tax Act as commonly described; confirm current rules with a tax professional.
eligibility: Annual contribution between INR 500 and INR 150,000
notes: Sovereign-backed. Partial withdrawal is permitted only after the scheme's stipulated period.
The rate is notified quarterly and can change; the value here is the notified rate for the stated quarter.

products.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
products.issuer: Government of India (Department of Economic Affairs)
products.tax_note: EEE treatment as commonly described; confirm current rules with a tax professional.
eligibility: Account opened by a guardian for a girl child below the scheme's age limit
Annual contribution between INR 250 and INR 150,000
notes: Only relevant to a household with an eligible girl child. It is not a general-purpose instrument.
The rate is notified quarterly and can change.

products.name: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme (SCSS)
products.issuer: Government of India (Department of Economic Affairs)
products.tax_note: Interest is taxable; deduction may apply under the applicable section. Confirm with a tax professional.
eligibility: Individual aged 60 or above (with the scheme's specified exceptions)
Deposit within the scheme's minimum and maximum limits
notes: Age-restricted: unsuitable unless the user meets the eligibility condition.
The rate is notified quarterly and can change.
